mechanism_narrative: A two-week recovery in TRANSIT from -47.9 to -39.7 means more subway and bus trips into commercial districts, which raises retail-and-recreation footfall over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -47.9 at t-2w to -39.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT has risen at least 5 points over two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has crossed above -45 for two consecutive weeks (-44.9 then -44.6), indicating commuters returning to offices; this restores weekday lunch and after-work retail demand over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days when WORKPLACES remains above -45 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A joint move of RESIDENTIAL below 10.5 and TRANSIT above -40 signals households substituting home time for out-of-home activity, lifting retail-and-recreation mobility over two weeks.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL < 10.5 and TRANSIT > -40, RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In the reopening regime after spring 2021 capacity easing, gains in PARKS and TRANSIT jointly pull discretionary trips back to retail corridors, raising RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -24.3 to -7.0 and TRANSIT from -47.9 to -39.7
failure_condition: In reopening regime, RETAIL_REC declines over next 28 days despite PARKS > -10 and TRANSIT > -40.

mechanism_narrative: Summer seasonal demand raises PARKS and outdoor leisure spending; because parks are near baseline (-7.0), this seasonal pull lifts retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is -7.0, the least negative among non-residential categories
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days while PARKS remains above -10.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently elevated RESIDENTIAL (10.0) together with deeply negative WORKPLACES (-44.6) indicates remote work keeps consumption local and suppresses Manhattan retail trips over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above 9.5 and WORKPLACES remains below -40.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing above -15 signals normalized essential errands and broader neighborhood mobility; adjacent retail-and-recreation visits follow within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the next week is lower than the prior week when GROCERY_PHARM remains above -15.

mechanism_narrative: A strong PARKS recovery above -10 while TRANSIT remains below -35 indicates outdoor leisure substitutes for indoor shopping, reducing retail-and-recreation mobility over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks is higher than the prior two weeks when PARKS > -10 and TRANSIT < -35.
